PHYSICS CRICKET

First-person 3D batting simulation. No preset shots. Just your bat, your hands, and genuine physics.

← BACK TO GAMES

🏏 Desktop (Mouse)

Click to lock the cursor and control the bat directly. Pull down for backlift, push up / forward to drive through the ball, and move left / right to aim and swing towards the leg side or off side.

Watch the colored pitch ring (green = full, amber = good, coral = short, cyan = yorker) and time your swing through the ball.

📱 Mobile / Touch (Joystick)

Drag the virtual analog joystick in the bottom-right corner. Pull down to cock your backlift, push up to drive, or sweep sideways for cuts and pulls.

⚡ Full Run Scoring: Score 1, 2, or 3 runs by piercing the outfield, 4 along the ground over the 58m rope, or 6 in the air! You have 3 wickets per innings.
